C1.name: Trend Seeker
C1.description: You like hunting down trending neighborhoods and cafés with friends and keeping busy well into the night.

C2.name: Romantic Duo
C2.description: Scenic viewpoints, city lights, and a great meal make your perfect day together.

C3.name: Family Adventurer
C3.description: Activities the kids can dive into, beaches, and camping suit your trips best.

C4.name: Active Explorer
C4.tagline: Walk, look, and take it all in
C4.description: Walking through nature and taking your time at historic places suits you best.

C5.name: Solo Recharger
C5.tagline: A quiet break on your own
C5.description: Walking and resting at your own pace, somewhere green and uncrowded, suits you best.

C6.name: Local Foodie
C6.description: Old-school eateries and markets where you can taste the region suit you best.

C7.name: K-Culture Explorer
C7.description: Filming locations, live shows, and shopping — getting close to Korean pop culture suits you best.

C8.name: Wellness Traveler
C8.description: Beauty and spa time, shopping, and good food at an easy pace suit you best.

C9.name: Nature Wanderer
C9.tagline: Out of the city, into nature
C9.description: Taking your time in regions known for their landscapes, like Jeju, suits you best.

C10.name: Heritage Explorer
C10.description: Palaces, museums, and regional cities where tradition is still alive suit you best.

jejuOwn.title: Jeju is an island — you can’t get there by car alone. Do you live in Jeju?
jejuOwn.resident: Yes, I live in Jeju — car only
jejuOwn.residentNote: Resident — you drive within the island only. With no intercity leg, day 1 starts at your departure time.
jejuOwn.ferryNote: Ship your car on a ferry from Mokpo, Wando, Yeosu or Busan. Pick a port in the ferry timetable below; vehicles usually board 1 hour before departure.

ulleung.title: Ulleungdo is reached only by ferry
ulleung.body: There is no rail, bus or air service to the island, so departure and return are counted only from the four ports with Ulleung sailings. Departure has been set to Pohang Ferry Terminal — switch it to the port you want.
ulleung.foot: Durations are each route’s fixed sailing time plus 40 minutes for boarding. The arrival port varies by sailing (Dodong, Jeodong or Sadong) and crossings can be cancelled in rough weather.

ferry.note: Indicative departures from the mainland. Frequency and times change by weekday, season and weather, and sailings can be cancelled — check the operator timetable before booking.

info.title: Travel info
info.hubPick: Choose a city to see its gateway

steps.wide: Pick the long-distance mode first (bus, rail, air, ship, metro, own car). Only matching terminals, stations, airports or ports appear as start/return points.
steps.route: If there are two or more routes (e.g. KTX / express bus), choose one in the prompt. The leg from home to the terminal is included.
steps.local: Choose rental car or public transit for local travel. Set date and start time to get a day-by-day route with travel times; stay time is editable per place.
steps.stay: Stays of one night or more get lodging candidates and booking links per day. Lodging is excluded from sightseeing time.
steps.jeju: Jeju allows air, ship, or own car (residents, or with a ferry) only.
